correctness.rationale: The even/odd aligned-pair counting proves the exact pointwise occurrence conditions: even n=2r has every even start and odd start iff t(q)=t(q+r)=t(q+2r); odd n has no even starts and odd start iff t(q)!=t(q+n). Signed-correlation finite recursions B_j(2r)=B_(j-1)(r), B_j(2r+1)=-(B_(j-1)(r)+B_(j-1)(r+1))/2, plus dyadic-interval boundary O(h log M), rigorously produce the ordinary natural limits. Triple-sign identity then yields both formulas. Induction identifies eta=-1/3 exactly at powers of two and eta=+1/3 exactly at 3*2^k; adjacent-extreme arguments give odd extremizers n=9,11,13,15 and global extrema. New independent direct digit-parity comparisons verified 12,800 (n,start) pairs for n<=64 and start<200, with exact first 16 rational densities; these checks alone do not prove infinite claims.

value.rationale: Fixed-length density of Abelian-square *occurrences* is a natural frequency invariant, different from word-factor complexity. The theorem supplies a uniform exact all-block-length law, strict parity patterns, and completely characterizes the largest and smallest frequencies. These sharp infinite families are structurally informative and not an arbitrary finite census.

final_claim: For every positive Thue–Morse Abelian-square block length n, indexed-start natural density is (1-eta(n))/4 for odd n and (5+3 eta(n/2))/8 for even n, where eta is the standard 2-point Thue–Morse correlation; global min 1/6 only at n=3, and max 3/4 exactly at n=6*2^k, k>=0.
limitations: Only classical binary Thue–Morse Abelian squares, not higher Abelian powers.
